text: A segment's label tells Oracle Fusion what it means. A value set tells Oracle Fusion what values are allowed in it — the literal list a user can pick from.

Four common validation types. Independent: a simple standalone list. Dependent: valid values depend on a choice made elsewhere. Table-validated: values pulled live from an application table. Format Only: just a format pattern to match.
Most chart of accounts segments use independent value sets. Dependent and table-validated matter more elsewhere in Oracle Fusion. Format Only is rare for core chart of accounts segments.

Each value carries its own attributes. Enabled controls whether it can be used on new transactions. Summary marks a value as a parent rollup. Posting allowed controls whether transactions can post directly to it.
A value set can be reused across segments when lists genuinely match, but reuse couples their maintenance together permanently. Next up, lesson twenty-three: account hierarchies and trees.
